title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Pat Surtain II (ankle) does not practice Wednesday
items.desc: Pat Surtain II missed practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Surtain remains week-to-week for the Broncos. He'll need to practice in some capacity by Friday to have a chance to return on Sunday against the Chargers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Quentin Johnston (chest) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Quentin Johnston was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Johnston totaled 44 yards this past week. He'll be an upside WR3/flex play in Week 5 if Ladd McConkey (foot) is sidelined.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ladd McConkey (foot) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Ladd McConkey did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: McConkey remains day-to-day. He has already played through rib and foot injuries early on this season. It may be in the Chargers best interest to let him sit a week or two.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Joe Alt (neck) not expected to play in Week 5
items.desc: Chargers OT Joe Alt is expected to miss Week 5 against the Broncos.
items.impact: Alt is expected to avoid being placed on injured list. He is week-to-week for now.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: DeVonta Smith did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Smith appears unlikely to return in Week 5 against the Jaguars.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Leonard Williams (ankle) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Leonard Williams was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Williams suffered an ankle injury late last Sunday against the Chargers. His status will need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaxon Smith-Njigba (rest) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Jaxon Smith-Njigba is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: It is a rest day to start the week for Smith-Njigba. He should be back practicing on Thursday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ty Okada (hamstring) logs full practice Wednesday
items.desc: Ty Okada was a full participant in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Okada will have a chance to make his season debut on Sunday against the 49ers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: George Holani (ribs) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: George Holani was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Holani remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zach Charbonnet (knee) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Zach Charbonnet was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Charbonnet was designated to return to practice last week. He is not expected to return this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brian O'Neill (knee) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Brian O'Neill was a limited participant in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: O'Neill continues to manage a knee injury. A limited practice to begin the week is a positive sign.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Aaron Jones Sr. (rest) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Aaron Jones Sr. was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Jones gets a rest day to begin the week. He remains a steady RB2 while Jordan Mason is sidelined.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Christian Darrisaw (concussion) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Christian Darrisaw did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Darrisaw was placed in concussion protocol to begin the week. He is unlikely to clear it in time for Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Justin Jefferson (ankle) officially limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Justin Jefferson was listed as a limited participant in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Jefferson is hopeful to return on Sunday. His status will need to continue to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jordan Addison (hamstring) officially a DNP Wednesday
items.desc: Jordan Addison did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Vikings coach Kevin O'Connell said Addison was dealing with soreness. He lands on the injury report with a hamstring issue. His status will need to be monitored in practice on Thursday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Morgan Moses (foot) listed as limited Wednesday
items.desc: Morgan Moses (foot) was listed as a limited participant on Wednesday.
items.impact: Moses was able to play through this foot injury in Week 4, but it left him limited at practice again on Wednesday. He should be able to play through it again this week, however, barring any setbacks between now and Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Braden Smith (foot) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Braden Smith was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Smith was designated to return to practice on Wednesday. He'll have 21 days to officially be activated.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) officially limited Wednesday
items.desc: Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) was officially limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: It was initially reported that Stevenson wasn't going to practice on Wednesday, but he ended up being a limited participant officially. This injury is still worth monitoring throughout the week, but it looks like he's slightly trending towards playing in a matchup against the Raiders this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kayden McDonald (ankle) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Kayden McDonald was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: McDonald was designated to return to practice on Wednesday. He'll have 21 days to officially be activated.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dre'Mont Jones (shoulder) limited Wednesday
items.desc: Dre'Mont Jones (shoulder) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran edge rusher was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday. This was to be expected, as he was able to play through his shoulder injury in Week 4. Barring any setbacks, he should be able to do the same again in Week 5.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tank Dell (knee) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Tank Dell was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Dell was designated to return to practice on Wednesday. He is unlikely to return in Week 5. He has 21 days to officially be activated.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Nico Collins (rest) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Nico Collins was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: It was a day to begin the week for Collins. He remains a locked and loaded WR1 for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jadeveon Clowney (knee) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Jadeveon Clowney was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Clowney is dealing with a knee issue. He should still be on track to be good to go for Sunday's game against the Titans.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Christian Gonzalez (shoulder) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Christian Gonzalez (shoulder) missed New England's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The Patriots were without their star cornerback in Week 4, and it looks like he could miss another game this week, as he was officially a non-participant at the team's first practice of the week on Wednesday. If he's sidelined, New England's secondary will be considerably weaker ahead of a matchup against the Raiders.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Carlton Davis III (neck) absent from practice Wednesday
items.desc: Carlton Davis III (neck) was absent from New England's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran is dealing with some kind of a neck issue and wasn't able to practice on Wednesday as a result. It would be very untimely if it leaves him sidelined in Week 5, with Christian Gonzalez (shoulder) also currently hurt for the Patriots opposite of him.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Azeez Al-Shaair (groin) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Azeez Al-Shaair was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Al-Shaair is dealing with a groin injury. He remains on track to be good to go on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Will Anderson Jr. (ankle) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Will Anderson Jr. did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Anderson was able to play through the injury last week. His status will need to be monitored to see if he can return to practice on Thursday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Christian Barmore (shoulder) limited Wednesday
items.desc: Christian Barmore (shoulder) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The big man was out last week due to a shoulder injury, but he was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday. He may be available to make his return to the lineup this week, but we likely won't know until Friday at the earliest.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dont'e Thornton Jr. (hamstring) logs full practice Wednesday
items.desc: Dont'e Thornton Jr. (hamstring) logged a full practice session on Wednesday.
items.impact: Thornton has yet to make his debut this season due to a hamstring injury that he suffered in the preseason, but he was able to log a full practice session on Wednesday and seems to be very close to a return to play. Las Vegas' receiving core will have much better depth when he's available to make his return to the lineup.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jeffery Simmons (back) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Jeffery Simmons is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Simmons is dealing with a back injury. His status will need to be monitored in practice on Thursday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Cody White (ankle) limited participant Wednesday
items.desc: Cody White (ankle) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: White was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday, though he's still being bothered by an ankle issue. It looks likely that he will play through it in Week 5, but we won't know for sure until later in the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tony Pollard (foot) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Tony Pollard did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Pollard has started the week missing practice on Wednesday most weeks. His status will still be to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Amani Hooker (concussion) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Amani Hooker did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Hooker will have till the end of the week to clear concussion protocol.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jackson Powers-Johnson (groin) logs limited practice Wednesday
items.desc: Jackson Powers-Johnson (groin) logged a limited practice session on Wednesday.
items.impact: Powers-Johnson was able to return to practice and participate in a limited fashion on Wednesday, which is a step in the right direction for his Week 5 availability. Las Vegas' offensive line will be nearly full strength if he's available to suit up and play this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: John Franklin-Myers (back) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: John Franklin-Myers did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Franklin-Myers will need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jalen Nailor (concussion) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Jalen Nailor (concussion) missed Las Vegas' practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Nailor left Sunday's game early after suffering a concussion and has since entered the NFL's concussion protocols. He wasn't able to practice on Wednesday as a result, and it looks like it will be a real threat to his availability for Week 5. Look for Tre Tucker and Cody White to see more opportunities if the veteran misses any time.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Brock Bowers (knee) limited at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Brock Bowers (knee) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Bowers was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday. This is likely just a load management move on the part of the team early on in the practice week, so fantasy managers should have no concerns about his outlook for Week 5 unless he's downgraded at some point this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mason Taylor (thumb) logs full practice Wednesday
items.desc: Mason Taylor was a full participant in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Taylor is on track to return on Sunday against the Browns. He remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tim Patrick (groin) logs full practice Wednesday
items.desc: Tim Patrick was a full participant in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Patrick had his practice window opened on Wednesday. He remains off the fantasy radar when he is activated.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kingsley Jonathan (knee) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Kingsley Jonathan was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Jonathan continues to deal with a knee injury. His status for Week 5 is uncertain.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dylan Parham (knee) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Dylan Parham did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Parham remains week-to-week with his knee injury.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Adonai Mitchell (finger) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Adonai Mitchell did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Mitchell remains week-to-week with his finger injury.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Breece Hall (quad) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Breece Hall did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Hall remains week-to-week with his quad injury.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jarvis Brownlee Jr. (concussion) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Jarvis Brownlee Jr. did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Brownlee will have till the end of the week to clear concussion protocol.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Savion Williams (ankle) officially limited Wednesday
items.desc: Savion Williams (ankle) was officially limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The Packers recently opened Williams' 21-day practice window, and he was able to participate in a limited fashion on Wednesday. He seems to be a long-shot to play in Week 5, but it looks like his return will come sooner rather than later, which is good news for the depth of Green Bay's receiving core moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Lukas Van Ness (shoulder) limited Wednesday
items.desc: Lukas Van Ness (shoulder) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Van Ness was able to play through this shoulder injury last week, so it shouldn't offer him any real struggles for Week 5, even though it left him limited at practice on Wednesday. His presence will be important for the Packers in a divisional matchup against the Bears this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jacob Monk (quad) a non-participant Wednesday
items.desc: Jacob Monk (quad) was a non-participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Monk was not able to partake in Wednesday's practice for the Packers, which doesn't bode well for his Week 5 availability. Green Bay's offensive front will continue to be weaker than usual for however long he remains out.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Aaron Banks (knee/toe) sidelined at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Aaron Banks (knee/toe) was sidelined at Green Bay's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: To no surprise, Banks missed another practice on Wednesday as he continues to battle with a pair of lingering injuries. It looks like he's trending towards being out for another week, which is bad news for a Green Bay offensive line that has looked terrible through the first four weeks of the season.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kyle Hamilton (groin) listed as limited Wednesday
items.desc: Kyle Hamilton (groin) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Hamilton is a new addition to Baltimore's injury report, being listed with a groin injury of some kind that left him limited on Wednesday. It remains to be seen what his official status will end up being for Week 5.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: John Simpson (groin) limited Wednesday
items.desc: John Simpson (groin) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Simpson was limited by a groin injury at practice on Wednesday, which doesn't come as much of a surprise, as this has been a nagging issue for him for a while. He should play through it in Week 5, assuming he suffers no setbacks with it between now and then.
